```plato

    // The acceleration every spring together imparts to one vertex: the summed
    // force divided by the vertex's mass, i.e. multiplied by its inverse mass,
    // so a fixed vertex feels nothing.
    SpringAccelerationOn(vertices: Array<ClothVertex>, constraints: Array<ClothDistanceConstraint>, index: Integer, settings: MassSpringSettings, dt: Duration)
        : Vector3D
        => constraints.Reduce(Vector3D.Zero, (total, c) => total + SpringForceOn(vertices, c, index, settings, dt))
            * vertices[index].SolverInverseMass;
```
